messages.author: 5063972801d34964
messages.subject: Default values for pc.cor0
parts:
Can anyone suggest good default / max entropy values for this pc.prior, say, for use with a AR process?

I am a bit confused by the notion of specifying a probability of being greater than some value when, in principle, the prior seems to favor shrinkage back toward zero. Thanks.

Jonathan

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Default values for pc.cor0
parts:
For the AR(p) process, there is a spesfically derived PC priors (based
on the same ideas), see


@Article{art634,
author = {S. H. S{\o}rbye and H. Rue},
title = {Penalised Complexity Priors for Stationary
Autoregressive Processes},
journal = {Journal of Time Series Analysis},
volume = 38,
number = 6,
issn = {1467-9892},
url = {http://dx.doi.org/10.1111/jtsa.12242},
doi = {10.1111/jtsa.12242},
pages = {923--935},
keywords = {AR(p), latent Gaussian models, prior selection,
R-INLA, robustness.JEL. C11; C18; C22; C88},
year = 2017,
note = {10.1111/jtsa.12242}
}


this is the default prior for the AR(p) in R-INLA
